name: Central Otago

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

keyfacts: It is New Zealand's only semi-continental wine region, shielded by the Main Divide from moist westerly winds, with large daily and seasonal temperature swings.
Soils include schist bedrock of mica and quartz, windblown loess and glacial outwash gravels that drain very well.
The subregions include Alexandra, Bannockburn, Bendigo, Cromwell, Gibbston, Tarras and Wānaka, with Gibbston the highest and coolest.

blurb.text: A South Island geographical indication and one of the world's southernmost wine regions. Pinot Noir is its best-known wine and covers about 81% of the vines. Pinot Gris, Chardonnay and Riesling make up most of the rest.
